title: Bolton pub named among UK's most haunted with reports of ghostly sightings
excerpt: Bolton’s Toby Carvery on Crompton Way has been named among the UK’s most haunted pubs, with reports of ghostly sightings, mysterious footsteps and unexplained activity
content:
A pub in Bolton has been named among the most haunted in the UK.

The Toby Carvery on Crompton Way features on a list of 13 haunted pubs compiled by Eat Drink Meet, a website that helps users discover nearby pubs, bars, and restaurants.

The building, once a grand mansion built by mill owner T.M. Hesketh in the late 19th century, has served many purposes over the years.

The Fairfield Arms in Audenshaw (Image: Arms Ember Inns Photography)

After the Hesketh family moved out, it was converted into a hospital for injured First World War pilots and later became a hostel for child refugees from the Spanish Civil War.

With such a long and varied history, it's perhaps no surprise the building is said to be home to a few lingering spirits.

A spokesperson for Eat Drink Meet said: "With such a colourful history, it's no surprise that guests and staff have reported seeing a mysterious lady haunting the upper floor of the building along with hearing disembodied footsteps and objects being moved.

"The cellar is also an area of supernatural interest, with many reporting feeling uneasy and as if they were being watched.

"Luckily the dining area is ghost free so those diners of a nervous disposition can enjoy a classic roast with tender, hand-carved meats served with all the trimmings or if you’re fuelling up for a long day of ghost hunting with one of Toby’s all-you-can-eat breakfasts."

Other venues featured on the list include the Fairfield Arms in Audenshaw, rumoured to be haunted by the ghost of a woman who was shot when the pub was still a private residence.

Eat Drink Meet described the Fairfield Arms as having a warm, inviting atmosphere despite its spooky reputation.

The spokesperson added: "The Fairfield Arms is rumoured to be haunted by the ghost of a woman who was shot back when the pub was a private house.

"Now she's said to wander the pub forlornly."

Other haunted pubs on the UK list include The Mitre Bar in Edinburgh, The Old White Swan in York, The Spaniards Inn in Hampstead Heath, and The Captain's Wife in Penarth.
